usgs-sgmc.title: The State Geologic Map Compilation (SGMC) geodatabase of the conterminous United States
usgs-sgmc.citation: Horton, J.D., San Juan, C.A., and Stoeser, D.B., 2017, The State Geologic Map Compilation (SGMC) geodatabase of the conterminous United States (ver. 1.1, August 2017): U.S. Geological Survey Data Series 1052, https://doi.org/10.3133/ds1052.
usgs-sgmc.notes: The first service is the official copy published by USGS ScienceBase for the data release. The second is an ArcGIS Online copy (publisher unverified), used only if the first fails. The 2026 GeMS update (https://doi.org/10.5066/P1A3DQZK) revised other states, not South Carolina.

scgs-24k-index.title: South Carolina Geological Survey 24K Scale Geologic Map Coverage
scgs-24k-index.publisher: South Carolina Department of Natural Resources, Geological Survey

scdnr-ftp.title: SCDNR Geological Survey GIS downloads (FTP)
scdnr-ftp.notes: 1:24,000 quadrangle shapefiles (one *_poly.zip and one *_line.zip per quadrangle) at ftp://ftpdata.dnr.sc.gov/gisdata/glc/. merge/scgs.py reads the polygon zips.

scgs-aiken-key.title: SCGS informal attribute key for the Aiken-area GIS data (Label, Unit_Name)
scgs-aiken-key.publisher: South Carolina Department of Natural Resources, Geological Survey
scgs-aiken-key.notes: Copied to data/lexicon/scgs_aiken_key.json (53 labels, each with its spreadsheet row).

usgs-geolex.title: USGS Geolex, national geologic names lexicon

scdot-roads.title: SCDOT road inventory: Statewide_Highways (state highway system) and OTHER_ROADS (county, city and private roads)
scdot-roads.publisher: South Carolina Department of Transportation (ArcGIS Online organization VaY7cY9pvUYUP1Lf)
scdot-roads.license: Public items published by SCDOT; no license is stated on the items. Shown live with attribution to SCDOT and not copied.
scdot-roads.notes: Read live by the viewer (web/roads.js) for the area on screen: ROUTE_TYPE and ROUTE_NUMB give interstate, US and SC route numbers; STREET_NAM gives names. CORS allows any origin. The public-domain alternative, U.S. Census TIGERweb (Transportation MapServer), could not be reached from the build environment to verify it.

county-parcels.title: County parcel services (property lines and tax map parcel IDs)
county-parcels.license: Each county's own terms; parcels are queried live and never copied (several counties restrict redistribution).
